new_today_news.headline: Wastewater treatment plant expansion approaching finish line
new_today_news.summary: The Weirton Sanitary Board's $28.6 million wastewater treatment plant expansion project is 99.9% complete. The project expands treatment capacity from 4 to 8 million gallons per day and was performed by Triton Construction.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors to Acquire EnviroServe for $470 Million
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors entered into a definitive agreement to acquire EnviroServe, a national provider of environmental and waste management services, from One Rock Capital Partners for $470 million. The acquisition is expected to close in H2 2026 and includes 40 locations with specialized fleet and recurring revenue stream.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Completes $30 Million Western Oil Acquisition
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors completed a $30 million acquisition of New England-based Western Oil to expand its Field Services business. The acquisition adds context to Clean Harbors' capital allocation strategy alongside higher earnings and continued share repurchases.
